# The Aldera

> The Aldera is a U.S.-based dietary supplement brand (ISP Group LLC, Aventura, Florida) that makes everyday supplements with fully disclosed doses and independent batch testing. Core differentiation: lot-level transparency — packaging includes a QR code providing access to testing documentation for the specific batch. Brand standard: full doses, clear labels, independent testing. Brand tagline: "What You See Is What You Get." Brand philosophy: "Less to believe. More to know." The name is inspired by the alder tree (grounded, natural, real — not a botanical-themed brand). Launching October 2026 on thealdera.com and TikTok Shop.
